proof_policy: Complete occurrence accounting against current retail 12.1.0, using twenty-one chronological later registers. Ten unused namespace retirements; 36 exact publication gaps. Published functions/events do not prove signatures, populated outputs, security, historical or native parity. Substantive extracts remain audit-pending; local targeted proof is not native/independent acceptance.

capabilities.scope: Publication/absence/event registration only; 93 OK / 36 exact gaps. Numeric-equivalent CVar default string difference is not default parity.
capabilities.proof: Twenty-two isolated sweeps, bare retirement RED/GREEN, cached Game prefork, loot successor shape, exact one-row negative control, format, default/Mists check and exit-0 startup [].
